notes: Form 990 filings found on ProPublica (EIN 943062436).

No tier 1 filing, no company-written LinkedIn headcount and no executive quote found. Form 990 line 5 trend (retrieved separately): 475 (2022), 518 (2023), 513 (2024). Line 5 counts everyone issued a W-2 during the year, so it can run above point-in-time headcount. A second LinkedIn snippet (/life page) showed 331 members, at a different date. Website figures of 13 million people served, 100,000 people and 15 employees (first-year hiring at founding) are not current headcount and were excluded. The 2025 Form 990 would not be expected yet.
